notes.title: 1.0.8 Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40937668/eb2bfb58cccea2bf8a040897b0aeeafbfe0933ae.png[/img]

1.0.8 update now supports Xbox, Playstation or any similar controller layout.
This update aims to be able to play Mithos on any standardized controllers and for the
upcoming Steam Deck platform.
